parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same flaw: move_card authorizes only the destination board via _require_editor(to_board_id) and never checks the card's current board (card.board_id), letting an editor of one board move any card by id from another private board, leaking its contents and removing it from the owner's board. Description A adds detail about sequential ids and comparison with other handlers, but the root cause and failure match.
